The '''Senate apartment complex''' was a luxurious, privately-owned apartment building located in the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]], on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] maintained a [[Naboo Queen (restaurant)|penthouse suite]] in this complex.

Toward the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was the meeting place of the [[Delegation of 2000]].
